messages:
maria: FYI — BluePeak asked for a security review call next Wed. They specifically want: RBAC change history, proof of audit-log immutability & retention, KMS/HSM key provenance and rotation evidence, and a short write-up of our vuln triage + incident response timelines. Need a draft packet by EOD Mon.

jake: I can draft RBAC change history and retention policy. Where do we pull the authoritative changelogs from?

anika: RBAC events are logged to `redwood-audit` in Splunk; we also export gzipped daily bundles to GCS with checksum. For proofs -> we usually share a signed export + our GCS bucket policy.

dan: I can extract the last 90 days of RBAC deltas. Quick Splunk query I use: 
```
index=redwood_audit event_type=rbac_change | stats earliest(_time) as first_seen latest(_time) as last_seen by actor, change_summary
```
That gives the actor+summary timeline.

maria: Nice — include who approved each change (we track approver_id in metadata). Also BluePeak asked about ability to roll back role changes. Add notes about our canary and rollback policy.

jake: For audit immutability: we retain logs 365 days in Splunk hot/warm, send weekly immutable export to GCS with object-level retention 400 days and write-once policy (WORM) enabled. Will add a screenshot of the GCP retention policy.

sec-bot: Scheduled export job `audit-export` completed: 2026-11-03T02:00:12Z -> gs://rw-audit-exports/2026/11/03/audit-20261103.gz sha256=af3b...c9a (retention=400d).

anika: For KMS: we use CloudKMS with CMEK for customer-dedicated deployments. On private/on-prem we recommend HSM-backed keys. Key rotation is automatic annually; manual rotation steps are documented. I can attach the `kms-rotation` runbook excerpt.

dan: To show key provenance + rotation proof, pull the KMS key-version history: 
```
gcloud kms keys versions list --key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/primary-key --format="table(name,state,createTime)"
```
Then include `auditLog` entries that show `CryptoKeyVersionDestroyed` vs `SetIamPolicy` events.

maria: BluePeak also asked about vuln triage timelines and how we track remediation SLAs. Short answer: triage within 24h for critical, 72h for high, tracked in Jira + weekly internal tracker. Need small example of a recent triage (no PII).

jake: I can sanitize the last critical (CVE-2026-1111) timeline: reported -> triaged -> patch rollout -> verification. Will redact customer IPs.

sec-bot: Vulnerability scan summary (2026-11-02): 0 CRITICAL, 1 HIGH (CVE-2026-1111, assigned), 3 MEDIUM, 7 LOW. Scan report: https://secure.redwood.internal/scans/20261102/summary

anika: One ask from BluePeak: Do we have playbooks for incident response and RTOs for Dedicated/Private? Short yes: playbooks exist and are exercised quarterly. Attaching runbook names and last exercise timestamps.

dan: For the packet, I'll include: RBAC export CSV, Splunk query & example output, signed GCS export metadata (sha256), KMS key-version list screenshot, vuln triage scrubbed timeline, and links to IR playbooks + exercise notes.

maria: Great. Action items: 1) Jake produce RBAC history + retention blurb (EOD Mon). 2) Dan produce Splunk extracts + example export metadata (EOD Mon). 3) Anika attach KMS runbook + key-version proof (EOD Mon). 4) Jake produce sanitized vuln triage example (EOD Mon). I'll compile and draft the call slide deck Tue morning.

jake: On it. Adding checklist: include the GCS signed object URL and a screenshot of bucket retention settings to avoid ambiguity. :thumbsup:

anika: I'll also add the HSM option note for Private customers and a short paragraph about our key custody model. :eyes:

dan: pinging @sre-bot to run an integrity check on today's exports just to be safe.

sre-bot: Integrity check started for job `audit-export` (run id=export-20261103-02). Will post results when done.

sec-bot: Integrity check results: all objects present, checksums match. No discrepancies.

maria: Awesome — thanks team. If anyone hits blockers DM me. I'll confirm call time with BluePeak once draft is ready.
